gh_4cb39f6675d3a84f550bc860.description:
## Location

* District 10, HCMC, Vietnam


## Summary
* We are looking for engineer with broad experience control and evaluate project quality. We expect candidates with capable of manual testing (Related to APIs, Mobile, Web, service servers, databases, etc.)

### Responsibilities

- Analyze complex software systems and collaborate with global teams to improve the overall design, testability, and quality of the platform
- Performing all testing activities across one or more projects, utilizing tools, scripts and software that ensure the quality and reliability
- Develop and execute test cases to diagnose issues and bugs, creating test data when required
- Working with a global team, communicating effectively with developers, project managers, business operations on test related information
- Identifying quality issues and drive corrective actions to resolve them

### Qualifications
- At least 3-years related experiences
- Solid knowledge about computer science (objected-oriented design, algorithms, data structures, databases, networks, etc.)
- Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes
- Experience designing and conducting Performance Testing, Security Testing, Migration Testing
- Experience in creating and proposing unit tests as well as integration tests that match the architecture and nature of the service. Ability to identify and escalate issues in a timely manner
- Good analytical and problem solving skills
- Good communication and interpersonal skills
- Growth mindset and eagerness to learn
- •ble to communicate in English efficiently in technical work
- Familiarity with Test Automation is a plus
- Experience with Payment or Fintech Service is a plus
- Experience with using AI in work

### Nice to have
- ISTQB/ISEB Certificate or equivalence
- Experience with working in micro services architecture
- Experience with working in Agile environment

### Contact

Send your CV to email: tungnt@linecorp.com
